mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have pleasant partly cloudy skies near the Reddan Soccer Park. If you are heading out tonight, the moon is in a waxing crescent phase. Also, look to the skies at 7:40 PM when the International Space Station will be visible for one minute, rising over Mount Horeb in the west southwest and tracking high in the sky toward Madison near the Home Depot.

In city news, we are tracking a report from September 10 regarding a burglary in progress on the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way. Officers arrived on the scene, took a suspect into custody, and recovered a handgun. There were no injuries reported.

It is a busy weekend in Verona. Today, we host the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival, along with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, we have Hop Haus Trivia and Lake Lou-ee Trivia on September 15, followed by Paddy Mac's trivia, live music, and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on September 16.
On September 10, Verona police responded to a burglary incident on Hunter's Cove Way, resulting in the arrest of a 19 year old male suspect on charges of burglary and recklessly endangering safety.
If you are craving something sweet, head over to Culver's today to enjoy the Really Reese's flavor of the day. They are currently open and will remain open until 10 PM this evening.
